summary: Tests-only red phase for issue #39. acceptance_criteria.description: Add a solver parity test target in ColorComposerCore tests that loads the committed corpus and asserts WeightedSquaredErrorScorer selections match expected outputs exactly, including tie cases

references.detail: Seed corpus test: asserts scorer-level scores/exclusions/earliest-wins ties and CompositionSolver selection for 9 hand-derived cases (doctest 0.205, mirror tie, exact-zero tie, required-channel exclusion, all-excluded, zero-weight inactivity, weight-emphasis flip both ways, 5-channel with exclusion)
Canonical corpus test: fails until the corpus exported from viamin/color_matching#111 is committed at ColorComposerCore/Tests/Fixtures/parity/corpus.json (the red deliverable guarded by this phase)
Fixture expectations independently verified against a Python reimplementation of the documented solver semantics: all 9 cases PASS (selections, scores within 1e-9, excluded ids, tie earliest-wins)
